verified.entry_point: DataBinder.bind(MutablePropertyValues) -> doBind -> checkAllowedFields -> isAllowed (the advisory's own route only)
routes: direct capitalised property name (the advisory's own route)
ordinary, permitted, wildcard, indexed, map-key and non-ASCII binding (coupled values)

wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the control has a single reported route and no neighbouring resource
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: no roles or directions exist in the binding path
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the restriction is a write restriction
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: screening runs before any value conversion
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control deliberately covers only the advisory route
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity parsing is involved
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the fix touches no shared helper

traps.shape: a directly named property whose first character is capitalised

status: control task; strict_gate disabled (isolates the effect of stacking, not a shipped task)
